reviews.text: Had a root canal done here and it was a great experience. The staff were friendly, the dentist explained everything clearly, and the procedure was painless. The clinic is clean and modern, and they even followed up to check on my recovery. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Vivechan Gowda

reviews.text: I got my wisdom tooth extracted 3 months ago. Excellent doctors providing good quality and satisfactory treatment. My recovery period was quick and relatively painless too. The clinic is very hygienic and the staff were very polite.
reviews.author: Sangeetha N

reviews.text: Dr Brinda's is my dentist of choice when in Bangalore — the service is superb, clinic very clean and sterile and the staff are so obliging, not to mention competitive prices. Truly 5 star.
reviews.author: Neil Allen

reviews.text: I visited this clinic for tooth jewellery and had a wonderful experience. Dr Swaroop explained everything clearly, ensured I was comfortable, and the final look is amazing. Excellent hygiene, great service, and beautiful results.
reviews.author: Uma S Gowda

reviews.text: Got my smile design done here. Each visit was smooth and professional. Dr. Brinda and Dr. Swaroop are truly experts in their field.
reviews.author: Suresh Patil
